scope: Selected nonvisual DOM carrier styling reference only. Core gesture/selection keys and observed composition cancellation are owned transport adaptations. DOM layout is never imported as Core geometry. Candidate-window placement, browser matrix, reader and autofill-service qualification remain open. Selection-only active-composition commands preserve the current observed text and composing range using DOM/EC selection operations. A real compositionend may update native composition metadata; this does not create or finish a composition in Core.
